name: Toilet Installation

faqs.question: How long does toilet installation take?
faqs.answer: Standard toilet installation typically takes 1-2 hours including removal of the old toilet, wax ring replacement, and proper sealing.

faqs.question: Do you supply toilets or do I need to purchase one?
faqs.answer: You can purchase your own toilet or we can recommend and supply quality fixtures that fit your needs and budget.

faqs.question: Can you install water-efficient toilets?
faqs.answer: Yes, we install all types of water-efficient toilets including low-flow, dual-flush, and high-efficiency models that save water and money.

faqs.question: What if the flange is damaged?
faqs.answer: We repair or replace damaged toilet flanges as part of the installation to ensure a proper, leak-free seal.

faqs.question: Do you remove and dispose of old toilets?
faqs.answer: Yes, we remove your old toilet and dispose of it properly as part of our installation service.

faqs.question: Can you install comfort height toilets?
faqs.answer: Yes, we install comfort height (ADA compliant) toilets which are easier to use for many people, especially seniors and those with mobility issues.

faqs.question: What about smart toilets?
faqs.answer: Yes, we install smart toilets with bidet functions, heated seats, automatic lids, and other advanced features, including necessary electrical connections.

description: Professional toilet installation services for new and replacement toilets
